thread:
mina: quick PSA — infra rotated several internal shortlinks overnight; I hit a 404 while following a runbook curl example. A quick ripgrep found multiple occurrences across runbooks, handbook, and a runtime guide.
rohit: thanks for flagging. can you paste the list?
mina: pasted: https://paste.redwood.example/links-327 (runbooks/oncall.md, handbook/setup.md, runtime/kv-cache.md + a couple of KB pages)
joel: i can pick up handbook + kb pages. small sed replace + changelog note should do it.
susan: i'll take runtime/kv-cache.md. heads-up: some matches are inside fenced output blocks — we should not replace those.
mina: i filtered with `rg "curl .*short\.rwd" -n docs/` then eyeballed contexts. here's a tiny helper to avoid fenced blocks: `python3 - <<'PY'
import re,sys
for p in sys.argv[1:]:
 s=open(p).read()
 if re.search(r"curl .*short\\.rwd", s) and "```" not in s:
  print(p)
PY`
rohit: nice script — i'll run a sweep after lunch and open small PRs.
docs-bot: Created ticket DOCS-4101 "Replace rotated shortlinks in curl examples" — please link PRs and include CODEOWNERS in the PR body.
joel: opened PR https://git.redwood.example/repo/docs/pull/1101 (handbook+kb). added changelog and @docs-maintainers as owner.
susan: draft PR https://git.redwood.example/repo/docs/pull/1102 (runtime) — running `npm run docs:build` locally then will request review.
mina: thanks — plan: merge after CI, run a quick site smoke test, then close DOCS-4101. leaving a short checklist in the ticket (verify curl, changelog entry, CODEOWNERS).
rohit: will do a post-merge pass for any leftover short.rwd occurrences. ping me if you want a hand. :thumbsup:
thread_summary: shortlink rotation caused 404s in curl examples; team running ripgrep + small sed PRs, helper script to skip fenced codeblocks, DOCS-4101 created, PRs opened, build & smoke test checklist
